tested: Group chat with several Kins and people across two PCs through the relay
Kins answer people and each other (at most 3 in a row), the Kin you name answers first
'X is typing…' on every screen; a Kin that can't answer says why
A guest's Kin answers through its own person's key
What the room tells a Kin is remembered on this PC and used in its next answers
limits: Kin voice notes and selfies can't be made here: Kindroid's API has no voice or picture endpoint. 'Read aloud' uses this device's own voice instead.
